description: Climate Change in the Northeast U.S. Shelf Ecosystem is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA | New England and Mid-Atlantic Fisheries Science Center; NOAA | Geophysical Fluid Dynamics Laboratory. This site is a resource for fishing industry stakeholders, researchers, and the interested public, providing an introduction to climate change science and climate change impacts on the fishing industry. It summarizes peer-reviewed, published research focused on historical and projected climate impacts on the ecosystem and living marine resources of the U.S. Northeast Continental Shelf. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Water Quality. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Aquatic and Marine Resources, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
